It also confirmed that provision in a barren setting can show its effect through lineage and response, reinforcing `ش ك ر B002`.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000560/B001","root_000726/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_12b84f97b2b57d25b608","text":"1. **A barren channel is converted into a settlement by ritual, attraction, and imported provision.** `س ك ن` `B002` (settlement), `و د ي` `B005` (valley as flood channel), `غ ي ر` `B005` (absence/otherness), `ز ر ع` `B001` (cultivation), `ق و م` `B009` (mainstay), and `ر ز ق` `B001` (allotted gift) form a non-agricultural urban mechanism. The valley lacks local cultivation, so prayer, arriving hearts, and fruits supply alternative supports. I infer settlement can be sustained by flows of devotion and exchange rather than native yield. The prayer reads as design for a dependent sacred economy.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000726/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_4b0b24b83a7bce02edb9","text":"1. **The prayer builds missing infrastructure from coordinated flows.** `س ك ن B002` supplies settlement, `و د ي B005` a valley as flood channel, `ز ر ع B001` cultivation, `ق و م B003/B004` undertaking and maintenance, and `ر ز ق B001` allotted provision. The valley lacks cultivation, so the prayer links dwelling → prayer → moving hearts → imported fruit; 14:32-34 had supplied water, transport, provision, and request. The packet supplies the nodes; I infer that ritual and social flows compensate for absent agricultural flow. Settlement reads as designed interdependence.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000560/B001","root_000630/B001","root_000726/B002","root_001273/B003","root_001637/B005"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-1","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_7b774eb77c3f3e059a16","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"14:37:3\",\"root_000726\",[\"B002\"]],[\"14:37:6\",\"root_001637\",[\"B005\"]],[\"14:37:9\",\"root_000630\",[\"B001\"]],[\"14:37:14\",\"root_001273\",[\"B003\"]],[\"14:37:22\",\"root_000560\",[\"B001\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Ekinsiz vadide yerleşim, ibadet, insan hareketi ve dışarıdan gelen rızık akışlarının eksik tarım altyapısını birlikte tamamladığı tasarlanmış bir karşılıklı bağımlılık düzenidir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":[],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:retrospective_surprises_md:1","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_9891a7d9b8c524e66d3a","text":"The hearts made air in 14:43 produced a sharp reversal: here `ف ء د` and `ه و ي` generate attraction and settlement, but there the same heart-field loses object, return, and inner density.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000205/B001"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_a8fbe3c930d2b426f8a9","text":"3. **Fruit can include the benefit generated by circulation.** `ث م ر B001` supplies literal ripe fruit and `ث م ر B003` the fruit of benefit. The land has no cultivation, yet people are asked to move toward it and provision to arrive; 14:39 then identifies offspring and answered prayer as gifts. I infer that material fruit remains primary while broader social benefit becomes visible as a second yield. `مِنَ ٱلثَّمَرَات` can thus activate both produce and the benefits borne by the new network.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000313/B001","root_000313/B003"],"citable":true,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"finding-5","source_type":"cross_run_publication","support_id":"sup_abc1dbf44cc2c7e36551","text":"{\"anchors\":[[\"14:37:12\",\"root_000313\",[\"B001\",\"B003\"]]],\"grade\":\"strong\",\"text\":\"Dokunulmaz sınır, sıradan kullanımı engelleyerek hareketin güvenle yöneldiği ortak bir merkez üretir.\"}","trust":"trusted"},{"branch_refs":["root_000810/B002"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:4","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_b416fce3de5e741492a3","text":"4. **Gratitude means visibly thriving on little.** `ش ك ر B002` supplies being sustained by scant provision and showing its effect, alongside recognition of favor (`ش ك ر B001`). The explicit absence of crops makes this branch unusually concrete: provision arrives despite a sparse base, and gratitude is the hoped-for result. I infer that thriving itself displays the gift. `لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْكُرُون` reads as embodied evidence of sustenance, not speech alone.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_000166/B001","root_000313/B001","root_000313/B003"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:3","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_ea488600206e6bc3410c","text":"3. **Protected bounds generate access by forbidding ordinary use.** `ح ر م` `B003` is an inviolable precinct and `B001` forbidding/barrier; `ب ي ت` `B001` is shelter. The apparent tension between barring and drawing hearts is structural. I infer the boundary creates a trusted center toward which movement can organize. The house reads as access-producing restriction.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001122/B002","root_001609/B002","root_001609/B004"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks","support_id":"sup_ee53c8658bf75d365fc8","text":"2. **Hearts “fall” toward people through heated inclination.** `ف ء د` `B002` pictures the heart as inner kindling; `ه و ي` `B002` is falling and `B004` desire/inclination. The construction makes hearts the moving subjects and descendants the destination. I infer affective heat supplies the force that crosses barren space; the prayer asks for embodied attraction, not abstract approval. The falling and desiring readings coexist.","trust":"legacy_unbound"},{"branch_refs":["root_001122/B002","root_001609/B004"],"citable":false,"role":"candidate_evidence","scope":"global","source_local_id":"reader_a:activated_readings_md:2","source_type":"v12_reader_walks_wide","support_id":"sup_efc82c054fbc168c0dc0","text":"2. **Hearts are both motive force and transport signal.** `ف ء د B002` supplies the heart as inner kindling. In `تَهْوِى`, `ه و ي B004` supplies desire and inclination, while `ه و ي B008` supplies fast going and bodies thrown into travel. The packet places hearts as subject, people as source, and the family as destination; I infer two coexisting mechanisms: affective attraction motivates approach, and that attraction becomes actual movement.
